tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Spillmark's free Amazon and Meta ads calculators (holdout test size, incremental ROAS, break-even ROAS, ACoS, TACoS, Amazon fees and profit, LTV and CAC), with each one's inputs and example values. Use run_calculator to run one.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Runs one calculator from list_calculators on your numbers and returns the headline result, the supporting figures, a one-sentence reading, and a link that opens the calculator with the same inputs. Missing inputs use the calculator's example values. Enter percents as points (15 means 15%), choices a

tools.name: how_lift_is_calculated
tools.description: Spillmark's method in brief: how a geo holdout test measures the sales Meta ads cause on Amazon, with links to the full method and a sample report on made-up numbers.
